title: Invoice upload template download with optional Ageing Days column

requirements.summary: Add a downloadable invoice upload template containing an optional "Ageing Days" column, and update UI help text and parser compatibility expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Admin Invoice Management (Raw Data Upload) page, provide a visible action (e.g., a button/link) to download an invoice upload template file (CSV or tab-separated text is acceptable).
The downloaded template header row includes all existing required columns plus an additional column named exactly "Ageing Days".

Uploading a file that includes the "Ageing Days" column still succeeds as long as the existing required columns are present; the importer ignores the "Ageing Days" values and does not require the column.
The "Required columns" help text on the upload card is updated to clarify that "Ageing Days" is optional and will be auto-calculated in the app.

file_operations.description: Create a small utility that generates the invoice upload template content (CSV or tab-separated) with the required headers plus an additional header named exactly "Ageing Days", and triggers a browser download with a sensible filename.

Add a visible download action (use the existing shadcn-ui Button component to keep styling consistent; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing) to download the invoice upload template, and update the help text under "Required columns" to explicitly state that "Ageing Days" is optional and will be auto-calculated in the app.

Ensure the import parser remains compatible when an "Ageing Days" column is present by explicitly treating it as optional/ignored (e.g., documenting and/or safely handling the extra column without requiring it), while continuing to validate only the existing required columns.
